mr_title: Renamed permissions upon model renaming in migrations.

expected_issues.title: RenamePermission queries the default database instead of the migrated one
expected_issues.description:
RenamePermission computes `db = schema_editor.connection.alias` but queries ContentType and Permission on the default database, so renames run against the wrong database in multi-database migrations.

Migrations are applied per database alias. The operation reads the alias into `db` yet uses ContentType.objects.filter(...) and Permission.objects.filter(...) without .using(db), so when migrating a non-default database the permissions of the default database are renamed (or none are found), leaving the migrated database inconsistent. The router/alias must be honoured for every query in the operation.
